opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers toward BitClub registration and frames participation as an investment tied to Bitcoin mining. It tells viewers to choose a company share and then “start getting daily passive income in Bitcoins,” while stating that a single purchase will provide equipment mining BTC for many years. Those claims are paired with unusually high recurring returns: “high profitability 3% to 5% per month, an average about 50% per year,” reinforced visually by “HIGH INCOME” and “FROM 3% TO 5% PER MONTH.” The material also attributes member income to the company’s mining operation and offers investment advice. The records do not establish that these returns occurred, or that external endorsements and reliability claims were verified.
